title.zh: 规定第787号法案《关于摩洛省组织与治理的法案》不得被解释为要求摩洛省检察长下属人员必须为律师且须依公务员法规定任命的法案
title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT ACT NUMBERED SEVEN HUNDRED AND EIGHTY-SEVEN, ENTITLED "AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ORGANIZATION AND GOVERNMENT OF THE MORO PROVINCE," SHALL NOT BE SO CONSTRUED AS TO REQUIRE THAT SUBORDINATES OF THE PROVINCIAL ATTORNEY WHO MUST BE LAWYERS SHALL BE APPOINTED UNDER THE RULES OF THE CIVIL SERVICE LAW.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT ACT NUMBERED SEVEN HUNDRED AND EIGHTY-SEVEN, ENTITLED "AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ORGANIZATION AND GOVERNMENT OF THE MORO PROVINCE," SHALL NOT BE SO CONSTRUED AS TO REQUIRE THAT SUBORDINATES OF THE PROVINCIAL ATTORNEY WHO MUST BE LAWYERS SHALL BE APPOINTED UNDER THE RULES OF THE CIVIL SERVICE LAW.
title.vi: Đạo luật quy định Đạo luật số 787 nhan đề 'Đạo luật quy định về tổ chức và quản trị Tỉnh Moro' không được diễn giải theo hướng yêu cầu cấp dưới của Chưởng lý Tỉnh phải là luật sư và được bổ nhiệm theo quy tắc Luật Công chức
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติกำหนดว่าพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่เจ็ดร้อยแปดสิบเจ็ดซึ่งมีชื่อว่าพระราชบัญญัติว่าด้วยการจัดตั้งและการปกครองจังหวัดโมโรไม่อาจตีความให้หมายความว่าผู้ใต้บังคับบัญชาของอัยการจังหวัดต้องเป็นทนายความและต้องได้รับการแต่งตั้งตามกฎแห่งกฎหมายว่าด้วยข้าราชการพลเรือน
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan bahwa Undang-Undang Nomor 787 berjudul 'Undang-Undang tentang Organisasi dan Pemerintahan Provinsi Moro' tidak boleh ditafsirkan untuk mewajibkan bawahan Jaksa Provinsi yang harus merupakan pengacara diangkat berdasarkan peraturan Undang-Undang Pegawai Negeri Sipil
title.ms: Akta menetapkan bahawa Akta Nombor Tujuh Ratus Lapan Puluh Tujuh yang bertajuk Akta mengenai Penubuhan dan Pentadbiran Wilayah Moro tidak boleh ditafsirkan untuk mensyaratkan bahawa bawahan Jaksa Wilayah yang mesti menjadi peguam dilantik di bawah peraturan Undang-Undang Perkhidmatan Awam

text.en:
Nothing in section five or in any other section of Act Numbered Seven hundred and eighty-seven,
entitled "An Act providing for the organization and government of the Moro Province," shall be construed to
require that fiscals or other subordinates of the provincial attorney, who shall by law be required to be
lawyers, shall be appointed subject to the rules of the Civil Service Law.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, September 9, 1903.
